theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ p ∈ C.support, p ≠ 0 → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (τ : Fin 2 → Euclid P) (c : ℤ), StrictMono φ ∧ ConvergesWeakly (fun j => blowUp C p (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C' ∧ MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C p (lams (φ j)) (hlams (φ j)).ne') C' ∧ Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ p ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) ∧ 1 ≤ c.natAbs ∧ HasMassDensity C p (c.natAbs : ℝ) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2, C' ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 2) x τ ∂μHE[2]
